conviction_note: Evidence is small and two-sided: an asset-sensitive bank got the second rate hike its Q2 guide called 'even more constructive' and the bar was cut by five brokers in early October, against slowing loan growth, peer deposit-cost and criticized-loan drift, a 5.8-point put skew and a name that sold its last two prints (-3.95%, -1.63%); findings sum +0.55 and the scaled number is +0.09 (p_up 51 on a 4.5% absolute move), the gap being that I do not trust the small positive lean against the skew and the reaction history.
bar: Q3 2026 adjusted EPS consensus $1.65 (Benzinga, Oct 13: https://www.itiger.com/news/2675355184; GuruFocus Oct 18: https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9129083/zions-bancorporation-zion-set-to-report-q3-earnings-on-october-19-2026), $1.67 (Tiger, https://www.itiger.com/news/1112993342), $1.64 (FMP); revenue $890-894m (Zacks $894.32m). Sources agree within 3 cents, so the bar is sourced. Company guide is one-year-forward only (Q2'27 vs Q2'26: NII, loans, adjusted fees and adjusted expense all 'moderately increasing'; FY26 positive operating leverage 100-115bp ex Visa) per the Q2 call transcript https://www.webull.com/news/15262048664429568. Q2 adjusted EPS was $1.74 (8-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000109380/000010938026000103/exh991earningsrelease20260.htm) but included an SBIC gain, so Q3 consensus sits below it.
positioning_check: Short interest 6,397,056 shares at the 2026-09-30 record date (FINRA published 2026-10-09), up 7.3% from 5,960,172 on 2026-09-15; 4.45% of float; 3.8 days to cover on ~1.64m ADV (https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/ZION/short-interest/). Not crowded, but building into the print. Baseline: 25-delta skew +5.76 vol points (downside paid), put/call OI 0.43, ATM IV 34.4% against 16.5% 20-day realised, event-implied move 6.78% against a 1.59% median and 4.21% max realised over the last 7 prints. Stock -14% from 52w high, -3.0% over 20 days, +0.6% over 5 days.

findings.finding: The FOMC raised the funds target 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on 2026-09-16 (12-0); Zions' Q2 NII guide (Q2'27 vs Q2'26 'moderately increasing') embedded only one hike from the June 30 curve, management said a second hike would be 'even more constructive' and that NII growth could reach upper single digits if the curve played out, and peers (M&T) now assume another hike in December, so the rolled-forward one-year NII outlook on this call is more likely to be raised toward upper single digits than cut.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (guide reiterated as 'moderately increasing', JPMorgan downgrade same week) the stock fell -3.95%; Q1 2026 -1.63%; Jan 2026 +4.21% was the largest up reaction of the 7 in the baseline. No clean read of a guide raise in the sample.
findings.why_not_priced: The hike is public, but the stock is -15% from its July high and five brokers cut targets Oct 1-9; if the market were pricing a raised NII outlook for the most asset-sensitive large regional, the shares would not have de-rated with KRE and the skew would not be +5.8 to the put side. Baird's Oct 15 upgrade cites the rate tailwind as a reason the stock is cheap, i.e. it is argued, not consensus.
findings.independence: Q2 call guidance quote (one hike embedded, two 'even more constructive'): https://www.webull.com/news/15262048664429568. Baird upgrade Oct 15 citing rate sensitivity: https://goldesel.de/aktien/news/zions-bancorp-aktie-baird-stuft-zions-auf-outperform-hoch-und-setzt-75-dollar-ziel. M&T Q4 guide assumes a December hike: https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-mt-bank-tops-q3-2026-estimates-as-shares-slip-premarket-93CH-4954133. Counterweight filed separately as the deposit-cost finding.

findings.finding: CEO Harris Simmons told the Barclays conference on 2026-09-15 (two weeks before quarter end) that lending growth 'has recently slowed', CRE growth is intentionally moderated and NDFI lending is flat, after Q2's 8% annualized linked-quarter loan growth; Q3 average loan growth, a driver of the 'moderately increasing' NII path, likely decelerated.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean history on loan growth alone; Q2 2026 printed 8% annualized loan growth and still fell -3.95% on core-quality concerns.
findings.why_not_priced: Said at a conference and summarised only by an AI summary on Quartr, not in a filing or wire story; consensus revenue ($892m) still implies ~+2.6% y/y growth. If priced, previews would flag loan growth as the risk; they flag NII and credit generically.
findings.independence: Shares one document with the deposit-growth finding below (same Barclays session). M&T said higher rates could slow loan growth (https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-mt-bank-tops-q3-2026-estimates-as-shares-slip-premarket-93CH-4954133); Regions flagged limited loan growth.

findings.finding: At the same Barclays session Simmons said deposit growth was strong and new consumer and business deposit products were 'exceeding expectations', with pricing aimed at replacing wholesale funding; in Q2 brokered deposits plus net overnight borrowings were ~$2.5bn and new deposits were said to be 30-40bp cheaper than overnight borrowing, so faster deposit growth lowers funding cost and supports NIM (3.27% in Q2).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 NIM flat at 3.27% and the stock fell -3.95%; the market has not rewarded margin stability on this name recently.
findings.why_not_priced: Qualitative conference remark, not quantified anywhere on the wire; peers' NIMs fell (M&T -5bp, Fifth Third -2bp) on deposit costs, and the market appears to be extrapolating that to Zions. If priced as a Zions-specific offset, Zions would have outperformed KRE since mid-September.
findings.independence: Same document as the loan-growth finding (one reading each of two separate statements). Q2 call figures on wholesale funding and deposit accretion: https://www.webull.com/news/15262048664429568. Q2 8-K customer deposits +4% y/y: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000109380/000010938026000103/exh991earningsrelease20260.htm

findings.finding: Peer credit drifted the wrong way in Q3: M&T (reported 2026-10-16) nonaccrual loans +$90m to $1.3bn and criticized loans +$245m to $6.1bn with management expecting some criticized to migrate to nonaccrual; Fifth Third (2026-10-19) NPA ratio 0.64% from 0.60%; Regions improved (NCOs 29bp, criticized and NPLs down). Zions' own nonaccruals rose to $292m from $279m in Q2, and credit is the line this stock trades on since the October 2025 loan-fraud charge-off.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: October 2025: a $50m fraud-related charge-off disclosure sent ZION and KRE sharply lower (KRE -6.1% on 2025-10-16); Oct 2025 print itself +1.39% once credit looked contained.
findings.why_not_priced: Peer prints landed after Zions last spoke (Sept 15, 'no significant credit deterioration'); the put skew suggests some of it is priced. Proxy only, peers point both ways.
findings.independence: Fifth Third Q3 release: https://www.financialcontent.com/article/bizwire-2026-10-19-fifth-third-bancorp-reports-third-quarter-2026-earnings ; Regions improving (counter): https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261016246924/en/Regions-Reports-Earnings-of-$611-Million-and-EPS-of-$0.71-in-3Q-2026 ; Zions Q2 nonaccruals: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000109380/000010938026000103/exh991earningsrelease20260.htm

findings.finding: Peers show the September hike already lifting deposit costs: M&T interest-bearing deposit cost +10bp q/q to 2.05% (about 2bp from the September hike) and NIM -5bp; Fifth Third interest-bearing liability cost +6bp, NIM -2bp; Wells average deposit cost +5bp. Deposit betas on the way up are the main risk to the asset-sensitivity thesis for Zions' NIM and for a raised NII outlook.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 NIM flat, stock -3.95%; no isolated history on deposit costs.
findings.why_not_priced: Peer data from the last three sessions; partly priced through sector weakness. Proxy, sized small; Zions said its deposit growth was strong, which partly offsets.
findings.independence: Fifth Third: https://www.financialcontent.com/article/bizwire-2026-10-19-fifth-third-bancorp-reports-third-quarter-2026-earnings ; Baird upgrade article names higher deposit costs as the offsetting risk: https://goldesel.de/aktien/news/zions-bancorp-aktie-baird-stuft-zions-auf-outperform-hoch-und-setzt-75-dollar-ziel

findings.finding: Zions closed the acquisition of Basis Multifamily Finance (Fannie Mae DUS and Freddie Mac Optigo agency lending platform plus servicing rights) on 2026-07-31; management explicitly excluded it from the Q2 guide and promised an update on this call, so Q3 carries two months of agency origination and servicing fees not in the guided fee path and a first quantification is likely tonight.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No history; first quantification of the platform. Fee line: Q2 customer-related noninterest income +11% y/y and the stock still fell -3.95%.
findings.why_not_priced: Terms were not disclosed and the business was excluded from guidance, so consensus fee estimates cannot carry it beyond a guess; revenue consensus of $892m (+2.3% y/y) does not look like it includes a new fee platform.
findings.independence: Q2 call: Basis excluded from guidance, update next quarter (https://www.webull.com/news/15262048664429568); close announcement (https://themortgagepoint.com/2026/08/04/zions-finalizes-acquisition-of-the-multifamily-business-line-from-fannie-freddie/).

findings.finding: The bar was cut into the print: Truist ($72->$67, Oct 9), TD Cowen ($73->$69, Oct 5), JPMorgan UW ($75->$65, Oct 1), Evercore Underperform ($68->$64, Oct 1), Piper ($71->$68, Oct 1) all cut targets, estimate revisions skew down, short interest rose 7.3% to 4.45% of float, and Baird upgraded to Outperform on Oct 15 on valuation (~9x 2027 EPS, ~1.4x Q2 TBV of $44.74), so the setup into the print is defensive.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Oct 2025 print after a sharp credit-driven sell-off rose +1.39%; Q2 2026 print arrived with a JPMorgan downgrade and fell -3.95%.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is by definition in the price; filed small because a lowered bar plus building short interest changes the reaction to an in-line print, and the put skew already reflects defensive positioning.
findings.independence: Short interest: https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/ZION/short-interest/ ; Baird upgrade: https://goldesel.de/aktien/news/zions-bancorp-aktie-baird-stuft-zions-auf-outperform-hoch-und-setzt-75-dollar-ziel ; downward revisions noted by GuruFocus: https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9129083/zions-bancorporation-zion-set-to-report-q3-earnings-on-october-19-2026

findings.finding: The terminated cash-flow swap headwind (~$8m in Q2) diminishes through 2026 with ~$8m left for all of 2027, a small mechanical NII tailwind in Q3 that sits inside the guided path.
findings.why_not_priced: Disclosed on the Q2 call and inside guidance, so mostly priced; filed at near zero.

baseline_tension: The small positive lean (rate hike for an asset-sensitive bank, lowered bar, building short) cuts against a +5.8-point put skew and a name that sold its last two prints, so p_up sits at 51 rather than the 54-55 the findings alone would suggest.
lessons_applied: Rule 7 (sign against strong skew): rate-hike guidance finding trimmed from +0.8 to +0.6 because I cannot say why the option market is wrong beyond a public macro fact; p_up moved 52 -> 51.
Rule 6 (inside what the company guided): swap-headwind finding cut from +0.1 to +0.05.
Rule 1 (verified fact is not a predicted reaction, name sold its last two prints): reported-quarter findings left small as drafted; reflected in p_up near 50, not in a second shrink.
Rule 5 (proxies small, not dropped): peer credit and deposit-cost findings kept at their drafted small sizes.
Bar check: consensus sourced to four agreeing aggregators within 3 cents, so no cap applied.
